name: Exp_JFatl_Digit_System
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom JFatl_Digit_System indicator, which combines a JMA-based digital filter with digit-level rounding. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions on a downtrend, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标JFatl_Digit_System的信号进行交易，该指标结合了JMA平滑和数字滤波器。指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，下降趋势信号时开空仓，支持配置止损、止盈和资金管理方式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用JFatl_Digit_System自定义指标作为核心信号源，该指标基于JMA（Jurik Moving Average）平滑算法并叠加数字滤波器来识别趋势方向。入场条件：当指标颜色缓冲区（buffer 6）的值大于2且另一缓冲区值小于3时，产生买入信号开多仓；当颜色缓冲区值小于2且另一缓冲区值大于1时，产生卖出信号开空仓。出场条件：买入信号触发时同时平卖仓，卖出信号触发时同时平买仓，实现了趋势反转时的反向平仓逻辑。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于净值百分比、基于可用保证金百分比和基于亏损后保证金百分比。资金管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制每笔交易的风险比例，止损和止盈分别默认设为1000和2000点。EA在新K线形成时才计算信号（IsNewBar机制），避免逐tick重复计算，但SignalBar为0时会在每个tick计算。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the JFatl_Digit_System custom indicator as its core signal source, which is based on the JMA (Jurik Moving Average) smoothing algorithm combined with a digital filter to identify trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator's color buffer (buffer 6) value exceeds 2 and another buffer value is below 3, opening a long position; a sell signal triggers when the color buffer value falls below 2 and the other buffer value exceeds 1, opening a short position. Exit conditions: when a buy signal fires, existing sell positions are simultaneously closed, and vice versa, implementing a trend-reversal exit logic. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance-based percentage, equity-based percentage, free margin percentage, and loss-adjusted margin percentage. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration to regulate risk per trade, with default stop loss and take profit set at 1000 and 2000 points respectively. The EA only recalculates signals on new bar formation (IsNewBar mechanism) to avoid per-tick redundant computation, though it processes every tick when SignalBar is set to 0.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制每笔交易的风险比例或手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot value

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：固定手数、余额百分比、净值百分比等
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/post-loss free margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: 指标相对当前K线的偏移量
parameters.description_en: Indicator offset relative to current bar

parameters.name: Digit
parameters.description: 数字滤波器的位数设置
parameters.description_en: Number of digits for indicator digitization

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Bar index for signal reading (0=current, 1=last completed)

pros: 使用JMA数字滤波器，信号平滑性较好，能有效减少虚假信号
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活度高，适应不同交易风格
新K线机制避免逐tick重复计算，降低计算负担
止损止盈参数可配置，风险控制有一定保障
买卖开关独立控制，可以只做多或只做空，策略灵活
pros_en: Uses JMA-based digital filter for smooth signals, effectively reducing false signals
Supports multiple money management modes with high flexibility for different trading styles
New bar mechanism avoids per-tick redundant computation, reducing processing load
Configurable stop loss and take profit provide basic risk control
Independent buy/sell switches allow directional-only trading, adding strategy flexibility
cons: min_rates_total在第72-73行被重复赋值，第一次赋值被覆盖，存在明显的代码错误
没有点差过滤，在高点差品种上可能产生不利成交
依赖自定义指标JFatl_Digit_System，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行
信号逻辑基于指标缓冲区的魔数常量（1、2、3），可读性差且缺乏注释
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在同一信号上重复开仓
cons_en: min_rates_total is overwritten on line 73 after being assigned on line 72, indicating an obvious code bug
No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable fills on high-spread instruments
Depends on custom indicator JFatl_Digit_System; EA fails if the indicator file is missing
Signal logic relies on magic number constants (1, 2, 3) from indicator buffers, poor readability and no comments
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same signal
improvements: 修复min_rates_total重复赋值问题，保留正确的最小K线数计算逻辑
增加点差过滤和持仓检查，防止高滑点成交和重复开仓
将指标缓冲区魔数常量替换为有意义的枚举或命名常量，提升代码可读性
improvements_en: Fix the min_rates_total double-assignment bug, preserving the correct minimum bars calculation
Add spread filter and position check to prevent high-slippage fills and duplicate position opening
Replace magic number constants from indicator buffers with meaningful enums or named constants for readability

risk_points: min_rates_total变量被错误覆盖，可能导致指标数据未充分加载时就开始交易
没有持仓检查，可能在已有持仓的情况下重复开仓导致仓位过重
没有点差过滤，在非流动性时段或高点差品种上可能产生不利成交
risk_points_en: min_rates_total variable incorrectly overwritten, potentially causing trading before indicator data is fully loaded
No position check may lead to duplicate position opening and excessive exposure
No spread filter may result in unfavorable fills during low-liquidity sessions or on high-spread instruments
